description: This file manages OAuth credentials for Google Gemini CLI, including environment variable resolution, credential extraction from files and directories, and credential cache management.

methods.name: resolveEnv
methods.description: Resolves environment variables from a list of keys.

methods.name: clearCredentialsCache
methods.description: Clears the cached Gemini CLI credentials.

methods.name: setOAuthCredentialsFsForTest
methods.description: Overrides the file system interface for testing purposes.

methods.name: extractGeminiCliCredentials
methods.description: Extracts Gemini CLI credentials from known paths or environment.

methods.name: resolveGeminiCliDirs
methods.description: Resolves potential directories where Gemini CLI might be installed.

methods.name: resolveGeminiCliSearchDirs
methods.description: Generates search directories to look for Gemini CLI.

methods.name: looksLikeGeminiCliDir
methods.description: Checks if a directory appears to be a Gemini CLI directory.

methods.name: findInPath
methods.description: Finds an executable in system PATH.

methods.name: readGeminiCliCredentialsFile
methods.description: Reads credentials from a specified file.

methods.name: readGeminiCliCredentialsFromKnownPaths
methods.description: Reads credentials from known paths within a Gemini CLI directory.

methods.name: findGeminiCliCredentialsInTree
methods.description: Recursively searches directory tree for credentials.

methods.name: resolveOAuthClientConfig
methods.description: Resolves OAuth client configuration from environment or credentials.
